name: The Rose
description:
Kingpin outlawed heroes. The Rose cashes in.
The heroes are outlaws now. The Rose works in the shadows of Fisk's city: every Fisk counter on Collateral Chaos and Lawless Justice brings his trap closer (Hero Resistance is how the heroes take them off), and when Mindstorm Uprising hits, the heroes' own allies turn on them. Face an Anti-Hulk Cannon, a mini-boss of your choice twisted to his side and a scheme you can over-defeat. A villain scenario for Standard and Expert, 15 cards. English and Spanish. Pairs with Fear No Evil.
